title: Sustainable synergy: unleashing the potential of biomass in integrated biorefineries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01293C, Review Article
Muhammad Kashif, Muhammad Ashraf Sabri, Michele Aresta, Angela Dibenedetto, Franck Dumeignil
The review sheds light on the various types of biorefineries and the various feedstocks employed, along with highlighting the major fuels targeted from these feedstocks, before discussing the conversion processes.
